T: Baked potatoes, mushroom stew and a chicken jockey.
D: Four misfits are pulled through a portal into the blocky Overworld and need Steve's help to get home.
P: Serve the drumsticks when the chicken jockey shows up.
S: Baked potatoes with butter, cheddar, crisp bacon, sour cream and chives

Potatoes baked until the skins crackle, split and loaded with butter, melted cheddar, crispy bacon, sour cream and chives. Heat the oven to 200C. Prick 4 large potatoes, rub with oil and salt and bake directly on the rack for 60 to 70 minutes until crisp outside and soft inside. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp. Split the potatoes, fluff the insides with a fork and add 15g butter each. Top with 120g grated cheddar and return to the oven for 5 minutes. Finish with bacon, 150g sour cream and chives.
Melon block skewers with mint sugar

Watermelon, rockmelon and honeydew cut into perfect cubes, stacked onto skewers like blocks and sprinkled with lime and mint sugar. Cut a quarter of a watermelon, half a rockmelon and half a honeydew into neat 2.5cm cubes, trimming them square. Thread onto 12 skewers in alternating colours, or stack into little towers on a board. Pound 2 tbsp caster sugar with 6 mint leaves and the zest of 1 lime in a mortar until green. Squeeze lime juice over the melon and sprinkle with the mint sugar just before serving.
Chewy chocolate chip cookie bars baked in a tin and cut in squares
Choc chip cookie dough pressed into a tray, baked until just golden and cut into neat square blocks while warm.
M: Sticky roast drumsticks in honey, chilli flakes and smoked paprika
Chicken drumsticks glazed with honey, chilli flakes and smoked paprika, roasted at 200C until sticky and charred at the edges.
Crafted mushroom stew with cheesy toast
the stew crafted from red and brown mushrooms

Mixed mushrooms browned in butter and simmered with onion, garlic, thyme, stock and cream until rich and thick, with cheesy garlic toast for dunking. Brown 800g mixed sliced mushrooms in batches in 40g butter over high heat. Remove. Soften 1 diced onion and 2 garlic cloves for 5 minutes, then stir in 1 tbsp plain flour and thyme. Add 500ml vegetable stock and the mushrooms and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream and season. Top 8 slices of baguette with garlic butter and 80g grated cheddar and grill until bubbling. Serve the stew in bowls with the toast.
W: Roasted pumpkin and condensed milk filling with cinnamon in a crisp crust
Spiced pumpkin custard in a shortcrust case, baked until just set and served with whipped cream.
K: Chocolate ice cream, milk and malted milk powder blended thick

Cold milk blended with chocolate ice cream, malted milk powder and chocolate syrup until thick, served in tall glasses with crushed malt balls on top. Drizzle chocolate syrup inside 4 tall glasses. Blend 500g chocolate ice cream, 400ml cold milk, 3 tbsp malted milk powder and 2 tbsp chocolate syrup until thick and smooth. Pour into the glasses. Roughly crush 80g chocolate malt balls in a bag with a rolling pin and scatter over the top. Serve with straws.

s.note: Baked potatoes with butter, cheddar, crisp bacon, sour cream and chives

s.note: Chewy chocolate chip cookie bars baked in a tin and cut in squares
s.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then mix in 200g flour, 1/2 tsp bicarb and 150g chocolate chips. Press into a lined 20cm square tin and bake at 175C for 22 minutes. Cut into neat squares while warm.

m.note: Sticky roast drumsticks in honey, chilli flakes and smoked paprika
m.how: Toss 12 chicken drumsticks with 4 tbsp honey, 1 tsp chilli flakes, 2 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp oil and salt. Roast at 200C for 45 minutes, turning and basting twice, until sticky and charred at the edges.

w.note: Roasted pumpkin and condensed milk filling with cinnamon in a crisp crust
w.how: Roast 600g pumpkin until soft and purée. Whisk with 395g condensed milk, 2 eggs, 2 tsp cinnamon and a pinch of nutmeg. Pour into a blind-baked shortcrust case and bake at 180C for 45 minutes until just set. Cool and serve with 200ml whipped cream.
